title: AI Guardian
subtitle: Your personal cybersecurity assistant. Ask me anything.
defaultGreeting: Hello {{name}}! I am your CyberShield AI Guardian. You can ask me about Digital Arrest, KYC scams, fake job offers, or report suspicious links for analysis.
prompt1Content: What is a 'Digital Arrest' scam? How does it work and how can I protect myself?
prompt2Content: I received a job offer asking me to pay a registration fee. Is this a scam?
prompt3Content: Someone called me saying my bank KYC needs to be updated urgently. Is this legitimate?
placeholder: Paste a suspicious message or ask a security question...
disclaimer: AI Guardian can make mistakes. Always verify critical safety information.
safetyWatchDesc: Guardians receive alert notifications when your safety session checks go silent or if you trigger SOS.
areYouOkayConfirm: Are you okay? Please confirm your safety now to prevent guardian alerts.
verifiedSafePromptLater: Verified Safe! We'll prompt you again later.
sosActivatedNotified: SOS ACTIVATED! Emergency contacts/guardians have been notified.
startSessionDesc: Heading out? Set up an AI safety timer. CyberShield will monitor your GPS path, require check-ins, and alert guardians if you go silent.
mustDesignateGuardian: You must designate at least one accepted Guardian before starting a safety session.
guardianAccessAuditLogsDesc: Transparent tracking of who has accessed your safety session logs, location telemetry, or responded to alerts.
acknowledgedAlertOtherGuardians: Acknowledged alert. Other guardians have been notified.
reescalatingAlertWarning: Re-escalating alert and warning all emergency contacts.
notGuardingAnyoneYet: You are not guarding anyone yet.
selectWatchedUserTelemetry: Select a watched user to see coordinate telemetry.
confirmRemoveGuardian: Are you sure you want to remove this guardian?
confirmEndSession: Are you sure you want to end your safety session?
promptExtendMins: Enter number of minutes to extend your safety session:
confirmActivateSos: 🚨 ACTIVATE EMERGENCY SOS? This will immediately alert all your guardians and share your location.
